risks.risk: Frame condition - rust, cracks, or structural damage not visible due to lighting/angle.

Clip of the bike being ridden or gears being shifted through the full range.
Close-up of any brand/model sticker or head badge on the frame.
Video of front suspension being compressed to show it functions.
Close-up photos of frame welds/joints and underside for rust or cracks.
response.reason: The item is clearly identifiable as a type (suspension-fork bicycle with multi-speed drivetrain and disc brakes) even without a brand/model, so it can be priced at worst case pending functional proof of gears, suspension, and brakes.
